correctness.rationale: At frozen tree 3b19d23a verified the 12-edge Q3 adjacency edge order and 792 seven-edge candidate subsets, of which exactly 384 are connected acyclic spanning trees. An independent complete 4096-mask integer Walsh butterfly produced the exact 10-level absolute histogram (zeros 1,522; nonzeros 2,574; least nonzero magnitude 8; max 384). An independent Walsh transform of the nonzero-frequency mask had |H| sum 56,972, giving unrestricted sharp Fourier projection norm 56,972/4096=14243/1024. Reviewed actual source verify.py: each of the 4,096 coefficients is independently checked against the signed Matrix-Tree 7x7 cofactor computed by fraction-free Bareiss, and compared to complete frequency_certificate.csv (4,096 rows); automorphism_orbits.csv identifies 144 Q3 orbits. Rank four over F2 of every signed Laplacian 7x7 minor modulo 2 gives at least three even-row pivots and determinant divisible by 8, while the histogram attains 8. Parseval and orthogonal characters justify rank, singular gap and pseudoinverse norm; averaging translations establishes the minimum over arbitrary endpoint projections. All arithmetic is exact and finite.

value.rationale: The three-dimensional cube is the first canonical hypercube with nontrivial independently signed spanning-tree frequency behavior and a manageable full Fourier space. The exact 1,522-dimensional kernel and 14,243/1,024 best endpoint recovery amplification characterize a natural graphic-matroid basis ensemble far beyond the classical 384-tree count. Its certificate gives a precise small-cube reference point for testing higher-dimensional signed-tree spectral conjectures, so this is a motivated finite invariant rather than an arbitrary slice.
